snippet.title: Boltgun 2 - Battle Sister Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Dive into the grimdark future of Warhammer 40K in Boltgun 2. As a Space Marine on a mission to purge heresy across twisted worlds, you’ll unleash an arsenal of brutal weapons, carve through demonic hordes, and fight across branching paths in a retro FPS style reborn. Every biome brings fresh fury, every enemy is a threat, and victory demands guts, speed and firepower. Check out this Battle Sister reveal from the Galaxies Autumn 2025 showcase.
